system.description: You were raised within a temple, monastery, shrine, religious family, or institution whose doctrine and observances shaped daily life.

legacy.name: Sacred Trust
legacy.text: The first time each Adventure ordinary Influence pressure would pass through your Reach and remove Temporary Influence or mark Core Influence, reduce that pressure by 1. This protection does not prevent Influence Breach.

familiarity.name: Sacred Practice
familiarity.text: You recognize common symbols, rituals, offices, doctrinal divisions, and forms of address used by established religious institutions. You can identify when a public observance differs from accepted practice, though you do not automatically know the reason.
